registration.claim: Among C. elegans putative enhancers accessible in exactly one of five tissues, the gene the domain rule attributes is tissue-concordant more often for elements in the constrained tier than for elements not in it, at the same tissue, position class, distance to that gene and measured length: constraint carries tissue information beyond the domain rule's position.
registration.constraint_cut: Per track, Zoonomia's own procedure on the track's own scores: p = 10^-|phyloP| for every scored base, Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.05 over all scored bases of both signs; constrained base = positive score at or above the cut. Distribution from a uniform sample of data blocks (consecutive groups of 16 blocks of chrI-V and chrX, 10% of the groups, seed 20261010), |phyloP| in 0.01 bins; cut interval: 1,000 bootstrap resamples of 1-Mb windows of the sample. No UCSC page or publication for either ce11 track gives a cut-off.
registration.tracks: Primary: UCSC ce11 phyloP135way (the most Caenorhabditis genomes, where worm non-coding sequence aligns at all). Beside, deciding nothing: phyloP26way with its own cut.
registration.element_tier: Exon bases of any WBcel235 transcript removed first (the human tiers are measured on unknown space, which excludes exons). Constrained: at least 5% of the remaining scored bases at or above the cut (budget.CONSTRAINED_MIN, the human rule for the regulatory class). Not constrained: below 5%. Not measured: no scored base left; excluded and counted.
registration.population: Stage 1's primary population (simpler_worm_registration): Serizay et al. 2020 putative enhancers accessible in exactly one of the five tissues by the source's call, with the domain rule's gene.
registration.endpoint: Stage 1's endpoint, unchanged: the domain-rule gene's TPM in the element's tissue >= 5 and strictly higher than in each of the other four; a gene absent from RNA_metrics is not concordant.
registration.matching: Strata: tissue (5) x inside a gene body or between genes (2) x distance bin of the domain-rule gene's 5' end (stage 1's 8 bins) x measured-length tertile (edges fixed in the census, from the primary track's measured bases). Only strata holding both tiers count.
registration.statistic: delta = concordance(constrained) - concordance(not constrained), standardised to the constrained elements' strata (each stratum weighted by its constrained count), in points; 95% percentile interval over 1-Mb windows, 2,000 resamples, seed 20261010.
registration.falsifier: The claim is falsified if delta is not above its within-stratum permutation null: the constrained label shuffled within each stratum 1,000 times (seed 20261011), one-sided p = (1 + permutations with delta >= observed) / 1,001; FALSIFIED if p >= 0.05.
registration.decision: CONSTRAINT_ADDS if the interval's lower bound > 0; CONSTRAINT_BELOW if its upper bound < 0; NO_DIFFERENCE_DETECTED otherwise.
registration.instrument_check: Before any scoring: in the genome sample the primary cut must place a larger share of CDS bases than of intron bases above it; otherwise the track read is declared broken (INSTRUMENT_FAILED) and nothing is scored.
registration.strata_beside: Deciding nothing: inside gene bodies and between genes apart; each tissue; the phyloP26way tiers on the same elements; the dose view (the primary's constrained fraction, top tertile against bottom tertile at edges fixed in the census, matched the same way), named because the 5% rule puts most measured elements in the constrained tier when 7.2% of the worm's non-exon scored bases pass the cut; the unmatched counts. If the primary is CONSTRAINT_ADDS and the between-genes lower bound is <= 0, the between-genes caveat is appended.
registration.confound: Stage 1 named transcription: an element inside a gene body can be open where its host is transcribed for that reason alone, and most worm transcripts are trans-spliced, so an element upstream of an annotated 5' end can lie in a transcribed outron. Constraint shares that confound: transcribed sequence can be constrained for splicing, trans-splicing or RNA-level reasons. Exon bases are removed and the position class is a stratum, but introns and outrons are not removed (outrons are not annotated). A difference therefore does not separate regulatory constraint from transcription-linked constraint.
registration.stop_rule: One run. Fewer than 200 elements of either tier in strata holding both: stop unscored (UNDERPOWERED). Nothing (cut, tier rule, strata, endpoint) changes after the RNA sheet is read; another definition is a new registration committed before it is run.

outcome_wording.common: On {n} C. elegans putative enhancers accessible in exactly one of five tissues (Serizay et al. 2020) with constraint measured on their exon-free bases (UCSC ce11 phyloP135way, cut re-derived at 5% FDR by Zoonomia's procedure), the domain-rule gene is expressed at 5 TPM or more and highest in the element's own tissue for {kc} of {nc} constrained elements ({rc}), against {ru} for the {nu} not constrained at the same tissue, position class, distance and measured length; difference {d} points, 95% {lo} to {hi} over 1-Mb clusters (within-stratum permutation p {pp}; {falsifier}).
outcome_wording.CONSTRAINT_ADDS: On this endpoint constraint carries tissue information beyond the domain rule's position.
outcome_wording.NO_DIFFERENCE_DETECTED: No difference was detected: on this endpoint constraint adds no detectable tissue information to the domain rule's position. This is not evidence that constrained elements lack function.
outcome_wording.CONSTRAINT_BELOW: Constrained elements' genes are less often tissue-concordant than matched unconstrained ones' on this endpoint; one reading named in advance is that constrained elements sit near broadly expressed genes, which an endpoint asking for the highest tissue counts against.
outcome_wording.between_genes_caveat: The difference is not carried by the elements between genes, where transcription by a host gene is not the explanation.
outcome_wording.always: Conservation and accessibility are not function, and this run does not separate regulatory constraint from transcription-linked constraint.
outcome_wording.INSTRUMENT_FAILED: The cut placed no larger share of CDS than of intron bases above it, so the track read is declared broken and nothing was scored.
outcome_wording.UNDERPOWERED: Fewer than 200 elements of one tier in strata holding both tiers: stopped unscored.

entry_script.why: argv[0] is a file inside this repository that git tracks and reports unmodified: the commit holds the code that wrote the bytes, so a rebuild can run it. The only clean form
entry_script.forms_are_decided_in_advance: genomeos.manifest.ENTRY_FORMS: one clean form (a tracked, unmodified file inside this repository), every other form refuses, and a form that cannot be classified is 'unknown' and refuses too. Read from sys.argv[0] at write time, never declared

code_cleanliness.counting_path_is_computed: the transitive import closure of this script, computed from the files' import statements at write time (genomeos.manifest.counting_path), never by importing: it follows every import that resolves to a file in this repository rather than only the package, counts the __init__.py of each package above a module, resolves bare imports against the directories the source literally puts on sys.path as well as the repository root, and matches every path component against what its directory lists, so a class name such as genomeos.genome.Genome cannot enter it as a file; not a hand-written list
code_cleanliness.note: several lanes work in this one checkout. A file under foreign_uncommitted_code belongs to another lane; this lane did not write it and did not commit it. The counting path is the computed closure above, so a foreign file outside it cannot have entered a number here, and foreign_uncommitted_code_on_the_counting_path names any that could

revision_stamps.sampled: code_cleanliness.git_sha is read while the writer computes; code.git_sha is read when the result is written. Both are HEAD of the same checkout at two moments

traced_inputs.note: Every file this writer opened for reading under data/ was recorded by an audit hook on the "open" event, canonicalised through data/'s links so one file has one spelling, and compared against the inputs the manifest declares; a member of a declared group counts as declared and hashed on its own, a file under a declared directory counts as declared by prefix. The hook is per interpreter, so a file read by a subprocess is not in this record, nor is one reached through a path that canonicalises to neither this checkout's data/ nor one of its link targets.
